summary: Compared the retained active-state source, render and diff for home-crop-selection. Outer geometry matches, but the active selections, product-type popovers and most vegetable entries shown by the source are absent from the render.
issues: HOME-CROP-01 high active state: expected 'owies' selected in orange and 'seler' selected in green, each with the visible Fungicyd/Herbicyd/Insektycyd/Regulator/Nawóz popover; actual shows no selected cards or popovers. Render the assigned active state and match popover geometry.

HOME-CROP-02 high content completeness: expected 17 vegetable cards across two rows (including burak, papryka, pieczarka, pietruszka, por, sałata, seler, marchew and ogórek); actual renders only eight vegetables and omits the second row. Restore every source-backed card in source order.

HOME-CROP-03 medium sizing/spacing: expected approximately 101x101 cards with 20 px horizontal gaps and section heading around y=94; actual cards are about 98x98, compacted into a narrower grid and the heading is around y=91. Match source card dimensions and row/column spacing after content restoration.
